analysis: The only changed file is docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The patch updates the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and the reconnect/backoff constants table near line 1937. The table now cites CoordinatorReconnectPolicy.swift, adds a 60 s stable-session backoff reset counted from the register frame, and adds a 0..1 s random reconnect wait after close code 1012. The supplied head units (lines 806-1725) are unchanged context and contain no diff hunks. This is documentation only, so there is no code, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or availability behavior change in the supplied evidence. Relevant threat areas are TB-002 (coordinator-to-provider WebSocket) and T-053, which covers stale connection and authorization after a connection change. The documented reconnect jitter and backoff reset could matter for availability, and for reconnect storms against the coordinator after a restart. I cannot verify the described CoordinatorReconnectPolicy implementation, and the patch excerpt is truncated, so I cannot confirm the documentation matches the code. Open integration question: confirm a reconnect after a 1012 close still re-registers and obtains fresh serving authorization (App Attest, TB-011) and does not reuse a prior grant. This is not evidenced as a regression. The unchanged text I read on the 806-1725 side references a shadow/live Autopilot lease, logout and unenroll behavior, and prefix-cache posture. I found no contradiction with T-041 or the other canonical entries. No findings.
